terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: These are the rules for using Ópalo. We wrote them as clearly as we could: if something isn’t clear, write to us.

aceptacion.label: Acceptance
blocks: By creating an account or using Ópalo (opalo.me) you accept these terms and our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>. If you don’t agree, don’t use the service.

tu-cuenta.label: Your account
blocks: You must be at least 14 years old to create an account. If you’re a minor, you need permission from your parents or legal guardian.
You’re responsible for what happens in your account and for keeping your password safe. If you think someone got in without permission, let us know right away.

nombre-de-usuario.label: Your username
blocks: Your username forms your link (opalo.me/yourname). You can change it once every 14 days; the old name becomes free for others after 14 days.
You can’t use names that impersonate another person, brand or company, or register them only to resell them. We may reclaim a name that breaks these rules.

lo-que-publicas.label: What you post
blocks: You own your content and you’re responsible for it. By posting it you give us permission to show it on your profile and in previews of the service. You may not post:

list: Illegal, hateful or violent content, or content that harasses other people.
Sexual content involving minors, under any circumstances.
Scams, misleading links, malware or attempts to steal data.
Music, images or videos you don’t have the rights or permission to use.
Other people’s personal information without their consent.

plan-premium.label: Premium plan
blocks: Premium costs 10 USD as a one-time payment. It’s not a subscription: there are no monthly charges or renewals, and you keep it for as long as your account exists and Ópalo keeps running.
You can request a refund within 5 business days of the purchase, as provided by the right of withdrawal. If it’s refunded, your account goes back to the Free plan.
Payments are processed by an external payment gateway. Ópalo doesn’t store your card details.

suspension-y-cierre.label: Suspension and closure
blocks: We may suspend or close accounts that break these terms, with or without prior notice depending on the severity. An account suspended for violations doesn’t get a refund of the Premium plan.
You can delete your account whenever you want from Settings.

responsabilidad.label: Liability
blocks: Ópalo is provided as is. We do our best to keep it working at all times, but we don’t guarantee it will be free of errors or interruptions, and we’re not responsible for the content users post or for the external sites they link to.

cambios.label: Changes
blocks: We may update these terms. If the change is significant, we’ll let you know by email or in the app before it takes effect.

ley-aplicable-y-contacto.label: Governing law and contact
blocks: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Colombia. For any questions, write to us at <support>soporte@opalo.me</support>.

privacy.metaDescription: What data Ópalo keeps, what it’s used for and how you can control it.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: What data we keep, what we use it for and how you can control it. We comply with Colombia’s personal data protection law (Law 1581 of 2012).

responsable.label: Who is responsible
blocks: Ópalo (opalo.me) is responsible for processing your personal data. You can contact us at <privacyEmail>privacidad@opalo.me</privacyEmail>.

list: Account data: email address and password (stored encrypted; we never see it).
Profile data: username, name, bio, location, photo, background, music and the links you choose to add.
Usage data: views and clicks on your profile. We don’t store visitors’ IP addresses; we use an anonymous identifier that changes every day.
Payment data: the status and amount of your purchase. Card details are handled by the payment gateway, not by us.

para-que-los-usamos.label: What we use it for
blocks: To create and show your profile, give you view statistics, process your Premium purchase, answer your messages, prevent fraud and abuse, and tell you about important changes. We don’t sell your data or show ads.

que-es-publico.label: What is public
blocks: Everything you add to your profile is visible to anyone who opens your link. Your email and your payments are never public. You can hide your location, badges and status from Appearance.

con-quien-los-compartimos.label: Who we share it with
blocks: Only with the providers we need to run: hosting and database, payment gateway and email delivery. All of them are required to protect it. We could also hand it over if a competent authority requires it by law.

cookies.label: Cookies
blocks: We only use the cookies needed to keep you signed in and remember your preferences, like your language. We don’t use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

tus-derechos.label: Your rights
blocks: You can access, update and correct your data, ask us to delete it, and withdraw your consent. You can do most of this yourself from Settings. For anything else, write to us: we answer inquiries within 10 business days and complaints within 15 business days.

cuanto-tiempo.label: How long we keep it
blocks: For as long as your account exists. If you delete it, we erase your data within 30 days, except what we must keep for legal or accounting obligations, such as payment records.

menores-de-edad.label: Minors
blocks: Ópalo isn’t meant for children under 14. If you’re a parent or guardian and believe a minor gave us data without permission, write to us and we’ll delete it.

cambios.label: Changes
blocks: If we change this policy in a significant way, we’ll let you know by email or in the app before the change applies.
